name: Robot Lawn Mower Store Price Record
description: Every read BestRobotMower.co has taken of the robot lawn mower prices that brand stores and retailers publish in their own product data, one row per model, seller and read, with the seller's list price and stock. The evidence behind the deals page, where a real drop is a price below the same seller's lowest price in the 30 days before.

columns.description: When the price was read from the seller's own product data (ISO 8601, UTC).
